verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an immigration law firm, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions responding to a Request for Evidence or a Notice of Intent to Deny. The pack covers visa types, attorney review before submission, and up-front case strategy ("identify any issues we foresee"). These describe initial filings and are adjacent at best, not documented RFE/NOID response work.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get help responding to an RFE or NOID — the provider documents request-for-evidence response work, not just clean first filings
